ImageField URL input uses placeholder 'Ou cole uma URL' consistently across all image zones — good UX consistency.
Video DropZone section lacks a dedicated data-testid on the outer DropZone wrapper div (only the inner content has data-testid=hero-video-upload-btn). Not a bug, just a minor testability note.
No image 404s observed in the screenshots — all preview images loaded correctly from the server.
